concerns.text: Task T001 verifies the quickstart command before the pipeline (`src/pipeline.ipynb` and related scripts) is implemented (Task T013). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation because the quickstart command cannot succeed until the pipeline code exists.

Task T006 computes a SHA‑256 checksum for `features.csv` before the descriptor‑gap check (Task T007) runs. Since T007 may abort the pipeline on gaps, the checksum should be generated after T007 to ensure only a validated feature matrix is recorded.
